localChanges: chore: work towards a 3D map, not offered yet: under ?3d=1 with the realistic sets, Cavalry stand, trot, slash with their sabres and go over with their horses with their own clips (#1417)

log: The same tool change as models-realistic-cc0#45: a stance can give a rider's joints (his and his horse's, the horse's bones named `mount_`), both tools check a figure's rules against its own bones and refuse a rider's plants, the bone heat falls back to the biggest piece of its voxel copy, and a stage can mirror a figure made the wrong way round. Nothing here uses them yet.

The same tools as models-realistic-by's: a figure whose weapon is part of it, held whole by a bone rather than a prop of its own, can fire from a muzzle the rig puts on that bone (rig.muzzle: the bone and where). Both tools check the rule and that the muzzle lies on something that bone carries. No model here uses it, and every rigged figure rebuilds as it was.

The tools rig a rider: his horse's skeleton and his in one skin, the horse's bones named `mount_`, its hips the root and his hips on its back. Both tools check a figure's rules against its own bones, and refuse a rider's plants. The bone heat falls back to the biggest piece of its voxel copy, without parts held whole. A stage can mirror a figure made the wrong way round.

The Cavalry are the first: regenerated with his right arm clear and mirrored, his own sheathed sabre's hilt dropped, and Poly Haven's Wooden Handle Saber in his right hand at the carry. He idles, trots, slashes at his right front (the blow lands at 0.55 s) and comes back through a guard, and dies going over with his horse onto its right side.
